question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A solemn promise
solution:
The correct answer is "**pledge**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pledge** means to give a **formal word** that cannot be broken. 

 
 
• **Example:** *The soldiers **pledged** to protect the country. *
 
 
 
• T
